_doc: Feeds of the Steam Blast Furnace (gtceu:steam_blast_furnace, recipe type gtceu:steelmaking).
server_scripts/grindless/steam/blast_furnace.js makes one recipe per row: 4 of `input` + 4 coke + 1 flux -> 4 steel + 1 ash.
Only iron ores that GTM 7.5.3 smelts straight into iron (furnace recipes of their raw ore): the oxides and hydroxides of
the Steam Age veins (iron, magnetite, hematite, goethite, yellow limonite). Pyrite is a sulfide: it waits for the LV
sulfide roaster. Raw ore gives 1 steel, as smelting it gives 1 ingot; macerated first it gives 2 crushed ores and so
2 steel, the same value as GT's own furnace + Primitive Blast Furnace route.
`vein` is the steam drill vein that drills it (informative).
